items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 46:1
items.html: One who subdues his will, that is, one who detains himself and does not receive although he longs greatly to receive, is said to restrict himself. (Part 1, Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 40)
